– after \"@\": the first instance wh.id: – after "@":     the first instance where that person/place occurs, unless the identity is uncertain and there is another that is certain. EG most common name is used for Abraham@Gen.11.26 where he is actually called Abram; the certain form is used for Ammon@Deu.2.19-Zep=H5983

Aaron@Exo.4.14-Heb=H0175.brief: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel
Aaron@Exo.4.14-Heb=H0175.short: Aaron was Moses' older brother and served as the first high priest of Israel.

Abagtha@Est.1.10=H0005.brief: One of King Ahasuerus' seven eunuchs
Abagtha@Est.1.10=H0005.short: Abagtha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

Abda@1Ki.4.6=H5653G.brief: Father of Adoram, who was over forced labor
Abda@1Ki.4.6=H5653G.short: Abda was the father of Adoram (or 'Adoniram'), who was in charge of forced labor during Solomon's reign.

Abdeel@Jer.36.26=H5655.brief: Father of Shelemiah, an official under King Jehoiakim
Abdeel@Jer.36.26=H5655.short: Abdeel was the father of Shelemiah, an official sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah.

Abdi@1Ch.6.44=H5660G.brief: A Levite, ancestor of Ethan the musician
Abdi@1Ch.6.44=H5660G.short: Abdi, a Levite, was an ancestor of Ethan, one of the musicians appointed by David to serve in the temple.

Abdi@2Ch.29.12=H5660H.short: Abdi, a Levite, was the father of Kish and served during the reign of King Hezekiah.

Abdi@Ezr.10.26=H5660I.brief: An Israelite who married a foreign wife
Abdi@Ezr.10.26=H5660I.short: Abdi, one of the descendants of Elam, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's time.

Abdiel@1Ch.5.15=H5661.short: Abdiel, son of Guni, was a chief of a Gadite family during the time of Jotham, king of Judah.

Abdon@1Ch.8.23=H5658I.short: Abdon was a son of Shashak and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

Abdon@1Ch.8.30-=H5658J.short: Abdon, the son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel') and brother of Ner, was a member of the Israelite community in Gibeon.

Abdon@Jdg.12.13-=H5658H.brief: A minor judge of Israel from Ephraim
Abdon@Jdg.12.13-=H5658H.short: Abdon, the son of Hillel the Pirathonite, was a minor Judge of Israel who led for eight years.

Abel@Gen.4.2-Heb=H1893.brief: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain
Abel@Gen.4.2-Heb=H1893.short: Abel, the second son of Adam and Eve, was a shepherd who was killed by his brother Cain.

Abi@2Ki.18.2-2Ch=H0021.brief: Mother of King Hezekiah of Judah
Abi@2Ki.18.2-2Ch=H0021.short: Abi, also known as Abijah, was the mother of King Hezekiah and the daughter of Zechariah.

Abiah@1Ch.2.24=H0029J.brief: Wife of Hezron, who gave birth after he died
Abiah@1Ch.2.24=H0029J.short: Abiah was the wife of Hezron who bore Ashhur after her husband's death.

Abi-albon@2Sa.23.31-1Ch=H0045.brief: One of David's mighty men, an Arbathite
Abi-albon@2Sa.23.31-1Ch=H0045.short: Abi-albon, also known as Abiel, was one of David's mighty men, an Arbathite.

Abiathar@1Sa.22.20-Mrk=H0054.brief: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon
Abiathar@1Sa.22.20-Mrk=H0054.short: Abiathar, son of Ahimelech, was a high priest who served during the reigns of David and Solomon.

Abida@Gen.25.4-1Ch=H0028.brief: Son of Midian, grandson of Abraham
Abida@Gen.25.4-1Ch=H0028.short: Abida was a son of Midian and a grandson of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

Abidan@Num.1.11-=H0027.brief: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus
Abidan@Num.1.11-=H0027.short: Abidan, son of Gideoni, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

Abiel@1Sa.9.1-1Ch=H0022G.brief: Father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul
Abiel@1Sa.9.1-1Ch=H0022G.short: Abiel, also known as Jeiel, Ner, or Abigibeon (or '[re]-founder of Gibeon'), was the father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul.

Abiezer@1Ch.7.18=H0044H.brief: Son of Hammolecheth, from the tribe of Manasseh
Abiezer@1Ch.7.18=H0044H.short: Abiezer, son of Hammolecheth, was a descendant of Manasseh and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

Abiezer@2Sa.23.27-1Ch=H0044G.brief: One of David's mighty men, from Anathoth
Abiezer@2Sa.23.27-1Ch=H0044G.short: Abiezer the Anathothite was one of David's mighty men and served as a commander in his army.

Abiezer@Num.26.30-Jdg=H0044I.brief: Clan of Manasseh, home of Gideon
Abiezer@Num.26.30-Jdg=H0044I.short: Abiezer, also known as Iezer, was a clan of the tribe of Manasseh and the home of Gideon, one of Israel's judges.

Abigail@1Sa.25.3-1Ch=H0026G.brief: Wife of Nabal, later married David
Abigail@1Sa.25.3-1Ch=H0026G.short: Abigail, initially the wife of Nabal, became one of David's wives after Nabal's death and bore him a son named Chileab.

Abigail@2Sa.17.25-1Ch=H0026H.brief: Sister of David; mother of Amasa
Abigail@2Sa.17.25-1Ch=H0026H.short: Abigail, David's sister, was the mother of Amasa, who became the commander of Absalom's army.

Abihail@1Ch.2.29=H0032H.brief: Wife of Abishur; mother of Ahban and Molid
Abihail@1Ch.2.29=H0032H.short: Abihail was the wife of Abishur and the mother of Ahban and Molid, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

Abihail@1Ch.5.14=H0032I.short: Abihail, a descendant of Guni, was a leader of the tribe of Gad who lived in Gilead.

Abihail@2Ch.11.18=H0032J.short: Abihail was the mother of Mahalath, who was one of King Rehoboam's wives and the daughter of David's son Jerimoth.

Abihail@Est.2.15-=H0032K.short: Abihail was the father of Esther (also known as Hadassah), who became Queen of Persia and saved the Jewish people from Haman's plot.

Abihail@Num.3.35=H0032G.brief: Father of Zuriel, a Levite leader
Abihail@Num.3.35=H0032G.short: Abihail was the father of Zuriel, who was the leader of the Merarite clan of the Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

Abihu@Exo.6.23-1Ch=H0030.short: Abihu was a son of Aaron who served as a priest. (Exo.6.23)

Abihud@1Ch.8.3=H0031.short: Abihud was a son of Bela and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

Abijah@1Ch.24.10-Luk=H0029L.brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
Abijah@1Ch.24.10-Luk=H0029L.short: Abijah was the head of the eighth priestly division established during King David's reign, and Zechariah, the father of John the Baptist, belonged to this division.

Abijah@1Ch.7.8=H0029K.short: Abijah was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

Abijah@1Ki.14.1=H0029H.brief: Son of Jeroboam I, died in childhood
Abijah@1Ki.14.1=H0029H.short: Abijah, the son of King Jeroboam I, fell ill and died in childhood, as prophesied by Ahijah the prophet.

Abijah@1Ki.14.31-Mat=H0029I.brief: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam
Abijah@1Ki.14.31-Mat=H0029I.short: Abijah, the son of Rehoboam, reigned as king of Judah for three years and continued in the sins of his father.

Abijah@1Sa.8.2-1Ch=H0029G.brief: Son of Samuel, a corrupt judge
Abijah@1Sa.8.2-1Ch=H0029G.short: Abijah was one of Samuel's sons who served as a judge in Israel but did not follow his father's righteous ways.

Abijah@Neh.10.7-=H0029M.short: Abijah was one of the priests who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time and was also listed among the priests who returned from the Babylonian exile.

Abimael@Gen.10.28-1Ch=H0039.brief: Descendant of Shem, son of Joktan
Abimael@Gen.10.28-1Ch=H0039.short: Abimael was a descendant of Shem and one of the sons of Joktan, as mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

Abimelech@Gen.20.2-=H0040G.brief: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac
Abimelech@Gen.20.2-=H0040G.short: Abimelech was a Philistine king who had dealings with both Abraham and Isaac, involving incidents where the patriarchs claimed their wives were their sisters.

Abimelech@Jdg.8.31-2Sa=H0040H.brief: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem
Abimelech@Jdg.8.31-2Sa=H0040H.short: Abimelech, a son of Gideon, declared himself king of Shechem but was eventually killed when a millstone was dropped on his head during the siege of Thebez.

Abinadab@1Ki.4.11=H0041J.brief: Solomon's son-in-law, an official in his government
Abinadab@1Ki.4.11=H0041J.short: Abinadab, the son of Iddo, was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath and served as an official in Solomon's government, overseeing the region of Dor.

Abinadab@1Sa.14.49-1Ch=H0041H.brief: Son of King Saul, killed in battle
Abinadab@1Sa.14.49-1Ch=H0041H.short: Abinadab, also known as Ishvi, was one of the sons of King Saul who died alongside his father and brothers in battle against the Philistines at Mount Gilboa.

Abinadab@1Sa.16.8-1Ch=H0041I.brief: Son of Jesse, brother of David
Abinadab@1Sa.16.8-1Ch=H0041I.short: Abinadab was one of the sons of Jesse and an older brother of King David, but he was not chosen to be anointed as king by Samuel.

Abinadab@1Sa.7.1-1Ch=H0041G.brief: Kept the ark of God in his house
Abinadab@1Sa.7.1-1Ch=H0041G.short: Abinadab, in whose house the ark of God was kept for 20 years.

Abinoam@Jdg.4.6-=H0042.brief: Father of Barak, the Israelite commander
Abinoam@Jdg.4.6-=H0042.short: Abinoam was the father of Barak, the Israelite commander who, along with the prophetess Deborah, led the Israelites to victory against the Canaanite army led by Sisera.

Abiram@1Ki.16.34=H0048H.brief: Firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite
Abiram@1Ki.16.34=H0048H.short: Abiram, the firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite, died when his father laid the foundation of Jericho.

Abiram@Num.16.1-Psa=H0048G.brief: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron
Abiram@Num.16.1-Psa=H0048G.short: Abiram, along with Korah and Dathan, led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed up by the earth.

Abishag@1Ki.1.3-=H0049.brief: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David
Abishag@1Ki.1.3-=H0049.short: Abishag, the beautiful Shunammite who served King David in his old age and was later sought as a wife by Adonijah.

Abishai@1Sa.26.6-1Ch=H0052.brief: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders
Abishai@1Sa.26.6-1Ch=H0052.short: Abishai, the son of Zeruiah and nephew of David, was a loyal commander and one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and military prowess.

Abishua@1Ch.6.4-Ezr=H0050G.brief: Son of Phinehas, grandson of Eleazar the high priest
Abishua@1Ch.6.4-Ezr=H0050G.short: Abishua was the son of Phinehas and grandson of Eleazar, who served as high priests in the line of Aaron.

Abishua@1Ch.8.4=H0050H.brief: Descendant of Benjamin, son of Bela
Abishua@1Ch.8.4=H0050H.short: Abishua was a descendant of Benjamin and one of the sons of Bela mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

Abishur@1Ch.2.28-=H0051.brief: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah
Abishur@1Ch.2.28-=H0051.short: Abishur, the son of Shammai, was a descendant of Judah; he married Abihail, and they had two sons, Ahban and Molid.

Abital@2Sa.3.4-1Ch=H0037.brief: One of David's wives; mother of Shephatiah
Abital@2Sa.3.4-1Ch=H0037.short: Abital was one of King David's wives and the mother of his son Shephatiah.

Abitub@1Ch.8.11=H0036.short: Abitub was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjaminite, and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

Abiud@Mat.1.13=G0010.brief: Son of Zerubbabel, ancestor of Jesus
Abiud@Mat.1.13=G0010.short: Abiud was the son of Zerubbabel and is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in the Gospel of Matthew.

Abner@1Sa.14.50-1Ch=H0074.brief: Saul's cousin and commander of his army
Abner@1Sa.14.50-1Ch=H0074.short: Abner, the son of Ner, was King Saul's cousin and the commander of his army; he later supported Saul's son Ish-bosheth as king before defecting to David.

Abraham@Gen.11.26-1Pe=H0085.brief: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people
Abraham@Gen.11.26-1Pe=H0085.short: Abraham, originally named Abram, was the patriarch whom God called to leave his homeland and blessed to become the father of many nations, establishing His covenant with him and his descendants.

Absalom@2Sa.3.3-Psa=H0053.brief: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.
Absalom@2Sa.3.3-Psa=H0053.short: Absalom was David's third son who led a revolt against his father's reign.

Achaicus@1Co.16.17-=G0883.brief: A Corinthian Christian who visited Paul.
Achaicus@1Co.16.17-=G0883.short: Achaicus, along with Stephanas and Fortunatus, visited Paul from Corinth.

Achan@Jos.7.1-1Ch=H5912.brief: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.
Achan@Jos.7.1-1Ch=H5912.short: Achan took devoted things, leading to Israel's defeat at Ai.

Achbor@2Ki.22.12-Jer=H5907H.brief: Official during the reign of King Josiah
Achbor@2Ki.22.12-Jer=H5907H.short: Achbor, also known as Abdon, was an official during the reign of King Josiah of Judah and was involved in the discovery of the Book of the Law and the subsequent religious reforms.

Achbor@Gen.36.38-1Ch=H5907G.short: Achbor was an Edomite king, the son of Baal-hanan, who reigned before the establishment of the Israelite monarchy.

Achim@Mat.1.14=G0885.brief: Ancestor of Jesus, son of Zadok (or 'Sadoc')
Achim@Mat.1.14=G0885.short: Achim was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew.

Achish@1Sa.21.10-Psa=H0397.brief: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David
Achish@1Sa.21.10-Psa=H0397.short: Achish, also referred to as Abimelech, was the Philistine king of Gath who granted refuge to David when he fled from King Saul, but later dismissed him due to the suspicion of his servants.

Achsah@1Ch.2.49=H5915H.brief: Daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur
Achsah@1Ch.2.49=H5915H.short: Achsah is mentioned as the daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur, in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

Achsah@Jos.15.16-Jdg=H5915G.brief: Daughter of Caleb; wife of Othniel
Achsah@Jos.15.16-Jdg=H5915G.short: Achsah was the daughter of Caleb, given in marriage to Othniel as a reward for capturing Kiriath-sepher, and she requested springs of water from her father as a blessing.

Adah@Gen.26.34-=H5711H.brief: Hittite wife of Esau; mother of Eliphaz
Adah@Gen.26.34-=H5711H.short: Adah, also known as Basemath, was one of Esau's Hittite wives and the mother of Eliphaz, who became a chief in the land of Edom.

Adah@Gen.4.19-=H5711G.brief: Wife of Lamech; mother of Jabal and Jubal
Adah@Gen.4.19-=H5711G.short: Adah was one of the two wives of Lamech, a descendant of Cain, and the mother of Jabal, the first to live in tents and raise livestock, and Jubal, the first to play the lyre and pipe.

Adaiah@1Ch.8.21=H5718H.short: Adaiah, a descendant of Benjamin, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

Adaiah@1Ch.9.12-Neh=H5718I.brief: Priest, descendant of Malchijah, during the post-exilic period
Adaiah@1Ch.9.12-Neh=H5718I.short: Adaiah, a priest and descendant of Malchijah, served in the house of God during the post-exilic period in Jerusalem.

Adaiah@2Ch.23.1=H5718J.brief: Father of Maaseiah, during the reign of Joash
Adaiah@2Ch.23.1=H5718J.short: Adaiah was the father of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king of Judah.

Adaiah@2Ki.22.1=H5718G.brief: Father of Jedidah who was mother of King Josiah of Judah
Adaiah@2Ki.22.1=H5718G.short: Adaiah of Bozkath's daughter Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah, who reigned over Judah and initiated significant religious reforms.

Adaiah@Ezr.10.29=H5718K.brief: A leader who married a foreign wife
Adaiah@Ezr.10.29=H5718K.short: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Bani, was among the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

Adaiah@Ezr.10.39=H5718L.brief: A priest who married a foreign wife
Adaiah@Ezr.10.39=H5718L.short: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Harim, was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

Adaiah@Neh.11.5=H5718M.brief: An ancestor of Maaseiah, a resident of Jerusalem
Adaiah@Neh.11.5=H5718M.short: Adaiah was an ancestor of Maaseiah, a leader who resided in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

Adalia@Est.9.8=H0118.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
Adalia@Est.9.8=H0118.short: Adalia was one of the ten sons of Haman, the enemy of the Jews, who was killed along with his brothers.

Adam@Gen.2.19-Jud=H0121G.brief: The first man, created by God
Adam@Gen.2.19-Jud=H0121G.short: Adam, the first man created by God, sinned and brought death into the world, but through Christ, the last Adam, came life and resurrection.

Adbeel@Gen.25.13-1Ch=H0110.brief: Son of Ishmael, grandson of Abraham
Adbeel@Gen.25.13-1Ch=H0110.short: Adbeel was a son of Ishmael and a grandson of Abraham, likely representing an Arab tribe or clan.

Addar@1Ch.8.3=H0146H.short: Addar, also known as Ard, was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.

Addi@Luk.3.28=G0078.short: Addi was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy in the Gospel of Luke.

Adiel@1Ch.27.25=H5717I.short: Adiel, the son of Azmaveth, was one of the officials in charge of King David's treasuries.

Adiel@1Ch.4.36=H5717G.brief: Simeonite leader during the reign of Hezekiah
Adiel@1Ch.4.36=H5717G.short: Adiel was one of the Simeonite leaders who, during the reign of King Hezekiah, attacked the Hamites and Meunites in the valley of Gedor and settled in their lands.

Adiel@1Ch.9.12-Neh=H5717H.brief: A priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
Adiel@1Ch.9.12-Neh=H5717H.short: Adiel (also called Azarel) was a priest who served in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

Adin@Ezr.2.15-Neh=H5720G.brief: Jewish exile who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel
Adin@Ezr.2.15-Neh=H5720G.short: Adin was one of the Jewish exiles who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian captivity, as recorded in the lists of returnees in Ezra and Nehemiah.

Adin@Neh.10.16=H5720H.brief: Jewish leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant
Adin@Neh.10.16=H5720H.short: Adin was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during the time of Nehemiah.

Adina@1Ch.11.42=H5721.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Reubenite leader
Adina@1Ch.11.42=H5721.short: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, was one of David's mighty men and a leader among the Reubenites.

Adino@2Sa.23.8=H5722.brief: Alternate name or description of Josheb-Basshebeth
Adino@2Sa.23.8=H5722.short: Adino the Eznite is mentioned in some translations of 2Sa.23.8) as one of David's mighty men, but the Hebrew text is unclear, and it may be a description of Josheb-Basshebeth's actions rather than a separate person.

Adlai@1Ch.27.29=H5724.brief: Overseer of King David's herds in the valleys
Adlai@1Ch.27.29=H5724.short: Adlai was responsible for overseeing King David's herds that were pastured in the valleys.

Admatha@Est.1.14=H0133.brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
Admatha@Est.1.14=H0133.short: Admatha was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

Adna@Ezr.10.30=H5733G.brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile
Adna@Ezr.10.30=H5733G.short: Adna was one of the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Babylonian exile and pledged to put away his foreign wife as part of Ezra's reforms.

Adna@Neh.12.15=H5733H.brief: Priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim
Adna@Neh.12.15=H5733H.short: Adna was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

Adnah@1Ch.12.20=H5734G.brief: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
Adnah@1Ch.12.20=H5734G.short: Adnah was one of the Manassite leaders who defected to David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

Adnah@2Ch.17.14=H5734H.brief: Commander of 300,000 troops under King Jehoshaphat
Adnah@2Ch.17.14=H5734H.short: Adnah was a commander from Judah who led 300,000 mighty men of valor in King Jehoshaphat's army.

Adoni-bezek@Jdg.1.5-=H0137.brief: Canaanite king captured and mutilated by Judah
Adoni-bezek@Jdg.1.5-=H0137.short: Adoni-bezek was a Canaanite king who was defeated by the men of Judah, and had his thumbs and big toes cut off as he had done to seventy other kings.

Adonijah@2Ch.17.8=H0138H.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
Adonijah@2Ch.17.8=H0138H.short: Adonijah was one of the Levites King Jehoshaphat sent to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

Adonijah@2Sa.3.4-1Ch=H0138G.brief: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne
Adonijah@2Sa.3.4-1Ch=H0138G.short: Adonijah, the fourth son of David, declared himself king when David was old, but Solomon was chosen to succeed David instead, and Adonijah was later put to death for his rebellious actions.

Adonijah@Neh.10.16=H0138I.brief: Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
Adonijah@Neh.10.16=H0138I.short: Adonijah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

Adonikam@Ezr.2.13-Neh=H0140.brief: Jewish exile whose descendants returned to Jerusalem
Adonikam@Ezr.2.13-Neh=H0140.short: Adonikam was one of the Jewish exiles whose descendants returned to Jerusalem from Babylon, as recorded in the lists in Ezra and Nehemiah.

Adoni-zedek@Jos.10.1-=H0139.brief: King of Jerusalem who fought against Joshua
Adoni-zedek@Jos.10.1-=H0139.short: Adoni-zedek, the king of Jerusalem, formed an alliance with other Amorite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites but was defeated and killed.

Adoram@2Sa.20.24-2Ch=H0151.brief: Official in charge of forced labor under David and Solomon
Adoram@2Sa.20.24-2Ch=H0151.short: Adoram, also known as Adoniram or Hadoram, was an official in charge of forced labor during the reigns of David, Solomon, and Rehoboam.

Adrammelech@2Ki.17.31=H0152G.brief: Assyrian god worshipped by Sepharvites in Samaria
Adrammelech@2Ki.17.31=H0152G.short: Adrammelech was an Assyrian deity worshipped by the Sepharvite people.

Adrammelech@2Ki.19.37-Isa=H0152H.brief: Son of Sennacherib who murdered his father
Adrammelech@2Ki.19.37-Isa=H0152H.short: Adrammelech, son of Assyrian king Sennacherib, assassinated his father.

Adriel@1Sa.18.19-2Sa=H5741.short: Adriel married Saul's daughter Merab and had five sons.

Aeneas@Act.9.33-=G0132.brief: Paralyzed man in Lydda healed by Peter
Aeneas@Act.9.33-=G0132.short: Aeneas, paralyzed for eight years, was healed by Peter in Lydda.

Agabus@Act.11.28-=G0013.brief: Prophet who predicted famine and Paul's arrest
Agabus@Act.11.28-=G0013.short: Agabus, a prophet, foretold a famine and Paul's arrest in Jerusalem.

Agag@1Sa.15.8-Est=H0090H.brief: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel
Agag@1Sa.15.8-Est=H0090H.short: Agag, king of the Amalekites, was spared by Saul but killed by Samuel.

Agag@Num.24.7=H0090G.brief: King mentioned in Balaam's oracle about Israel
Agag@Num.24.7=H0090G.short: Agag, a king, is mentioned in Balaam's prophetic oracle about Israel's future.

Agee@2Sa.23.11=H0089.brief: Father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men
Agee@2Sa.23.11=H0089.short: Agee the Hararite was the father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men.

Agrippa@Act.25.13-=G0067.brief: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea
Agrippa@Act.25.13-=G0067.short: Tetrarch Agrippa heard Paul's defense and found no grounds for his imprisonment.

Agur@Pro.30.1=H0094.brief: Author of Proverbs 30, son of Jakeh
Agur@Pro.30.1=H0094.short: Agur, son of Jakeh, is credited as the author of Proverbs 30.

Ahab@1Ki.16.28-Mic=H0256G.brief: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel
Ahab@1Ki.16.28-Mic=H0256G.short: Ahab, son of Omri, reigned as king of Israel and did evil in the sight of the Lord.

Ahab@Jer.29.21-=H0256H.brief: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
Ahab@Jer.29.21-=H0256H.short: Ahab, son of Kolaiah, was a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

Aharhel@1Ch.4.8=H0316.brief: Son of Harum, from the tribe of Judah
Aharhel@1Ch.4.8=H0316.short: Aharhel was a son of Harum, a descendant of Judah.

Ahasbai@2Sa.23.34=H0308.brief: Father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men
Ahasbai@2Sa.23.34=H0308.short: Ahasbai the Maachathite was the father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men.

Ahasuerus@Ezr.4.6-Dan=H0325.brief: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther
Ahasuerus@Ezr.4.6-Dan=H0325.short: Ahasuerus, Emperor of Persia (probably Xerxes I), chose Esther as his queen and issued decrees impacting the Jews.

Ahaz@1Ch.8.35-=H0271H.short: Ahaz was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan, from the tribe of Benjamin.

Ahaz@2Ki.15.38-Mat=H0271G.brief: King of Judah, son of Jotham
Ahaz@2Ki.15.38-Mat=H0271G.short: Ahaz, son of Jotham, reigned as king of Judah for 16 years.

Ahaziah@1Ki.22.40-2Ch=H0274G.brief: King of Israel, son of Ahab
Ahaziah@1Ki.22.40-2Ch=H0274G.short: Ahaziah, son of Ahab, reigned as king of Israel for two years.

Ahaziah@2Ki.8.24-2Ch=H0274H.brief: King of Judah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah
Ahaziah@2Ki.8.24-2Ch=H0274H.short: Ahaziah (also called Jehoahaz), son of Jehoram, reigned as king of Judah for one year.

Ahban@1Ch.2.29=H0257.brief: Son of Abishur, from the tribe of Judah
Ahban@1Ch.2.29=H0257.short: Ahban was the son of Abishur, a descendant of Judah.

Aher@1Ch.7.12=H0313.brief: Son of Shemer, from the tribe of Asher
Aher@1Ch.7.12=H0313.short: Aher was a son of Shemer, a descendant of Asher.

Ahi@1Ch.5.15=H0277G.brief: Son of Abdiel, a Gadite chief
Ahi@1Ch.5.15=H0277G.short: Ahi, son of Abdiel, was a chief of the Gadites.

Ahi@1Ch.7.34=H0277H.brief: Son of Shomer, from the tribe of Asher
Ahi@1Ch.7.34=H0277H.short: Ahi (or "brother") was a son of Shomer (or 'Shamer'), a descendant of Asher.

Ahiah@Neh.10.26=H0281N.brief: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
Ahiah@Neh.10.26=H0281N.short: Ahiah was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

Ahiam@2Sa.23.33-1Ch=H0279.brief: One of David's mighty men, son of Sharar
Ahiam@2Sa.23.33-1Ch=H0279.short: Ahiam, son of Sharar the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men.

Ahian@1Ch.7.19=H0291.brief: Son of Shemidah, from the tribe of Manasseh
Ahian@1Ch.7.19=H0291.short: Ahian was a son of Shemidah, a descendant of Manasseh.

Ahiezer@1Ch.12.3=H0295H.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
Ahiezer@1Ch.12.3=H0295H.short: Ahiezer was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

Ahiezer@Num.1.12-=H0295G.brief: Leader from the tribe of Dan during the Exodus
Ahiezer@Num.1.12-=H0295G.short: Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, was a leader of the tribe of Dan during the Exodus.

Ahihud@1Ch.8.7=H0284.brief: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
Ahihud@1Ch.8.7=H0284.short: Ahihud was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

Ahihud@Num.34.27=H0282.brief: Leader from the tribe of Asher for land allocation
Ahihud@Num.34.27=H0282.short: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was a leader from the tribe of Asher appointed to help allocate the Promised Land.

Ahijah@1Ch.11.36=H0281L.brief: One of David's mighty men, the Pelonite
Ahijah@1Ch.11.36=H0281L.short: Ahijah the Pelonite was one of David's mighty men.

Ahijah@1Ch.2.25=H0281J.brief: Son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah
Ahijah@1Ch.2.25=H0281J.short: Ahijah was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

Ahijah@1Ch.26.20=H0281M.brief: Levite in charge of the treasuries of the temple
Ahijah@1Ch.26.20=H0281M.short: Ahijah, a Levite, was in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.

Ahijah@1Ch.8.7=H0281K.brief: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
Ahijah@1Ch.8.7=H0281K.short: Ahijah was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

Ahijah@1Ki.11.29-2Ch=H0281H.brief: Prophet from Shiloh who prophesied to Jeroboam
Ahijah@1Ki.11.29-2Ch=H0281H.short: Ahijah the Shilonite was a prophet who foretold Jeroboam's rise to power and the division of the kingdom.

Ahijah@1Ki.15.27-2Ki=H0281I.brief: Father of Baasha, king of Israel
Ahijah@1Ki.15.27-2Ki=H0281I.short: Ahijah was the father of Baasha, who became king of Israel and ruled for 24 years.

Ahijah@1Ki.4.3=H0281G.brief: Son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), a scribe during Solomon's reign
Ahijah@1Ki.4.3=H0281G.short: Ahijah, son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), served as a scribe during King Solomon's reign.

Ahikam@2Ki.22.12-Jer=H0296.brief: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death
Ahikam@2Ki.22.12-Jer=H0296.short: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was an official during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim, and he protected Jeremiah from death.

Ahilud@2Sa.8.16-1Ch=H0286.brief: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon
Ahilud@2Sa.8.16-1Ch=H0286.short: Ahilud was the father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder, and Baana, one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

Ahimaaz@1Ki.4.15=H0290I.short: Ahimaaz, who was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath, served as the governor of Naphtali during Solomon's reign.

Ahimaaz@1Sa.14.50=H0290G.short: Ahimaaz was the father of Ahinoam, who was the wife of King Saul.

Ahimaaz@2Sa.15.27-1Ch=H0290H.brief: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David
Ahimaaz@2Sa.15.27-1Ch=H0290H.short: Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, was a messenger who helped David during Absalom's rebellion and brought news of Absalom's death.

Ahiman@1Ch.9.17=H0289H.short: Ahiman was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of David.

Ahiman@Num.13.22-Jdg=H0289G.brief: One of the giant descendants of Anak in Hebron
Ahiman@Num.13.22-Jdg=H0289G.short: Ahiman was one of the three giant descendants of Anak who lived in Hebron and were driven out by Caleb.

Ahimelech@1Sa.14.3-Psa=H0288G.brief: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul
Ahimelech@1Sa.14.3-Psa=H0288G.short: Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob, gave David consecrated bread and Goliath's sword but was later killed by Saul for aiding David.

Ahimelech@1Sa.26.6=H0288H.brief: Son of Ahitub, a Hittite warrior who joined David
Ahimelech@1Sa.26.6=H0288H.short: Ahimelech the Hittite was one of David's warriors who accompanied him to Saul's camp while Saul was pursuing David.

Ahimelech@2Sa.8.17-1Ch=H0288I.brief: Son of Abiathar, a priest during David's reign
Ahimelech@2Sa.8.17-1Ch=H0288I.short: Ahimelech, son of Abiathar, served as a priest during the reign of King David.

Ahimoth@1Ch.6.25-=H0287.brief: Levite descendant of Kohath, son of Elkanah
Ahimoth@1Ch.6.25-=H0287.short: Ahimoth, also known as Mahath, was a Levite descended from Kohath, the son of Elkanah.

Ahinadab@1Ki.4.14=H0292.brief: Son of Iddo, a governor under Solomon
Ahinadab@1Ki.4.14=H0292.short: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, was one of Solomon's twelve governors, responsible for providing provisions for the king's household.

Ahinoam@1Sa.14.50=H0293G.brief: Wife of King Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
Ahinoam@1Sa.14.50=H0293G.short: Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz, was one of King Saul's wives.

Ahinoam@1Sa.25.43-1Ch=H0293H.brief: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon
Ahinoam@1Sa.25.43-1Ch=H0293H.short: Ahinoam of Jezreel was one of David's wives and the mother of his firstborn son, Amnon.

Ahio@1Ch.8.14=H0283H.short: Ahio was a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

Ahio@1Ch.8.31-=H0283I.short: Ahio was a son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), a Benjamite who was the re-founder of Gibeon.

Ahio@2Sa.6.3-1Ch=H0283G.brief: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim
Ahio@2Sa.6.3-1Ch=H0283G.short: Ahio, along with his brother Uzzah, drove the cart carrying the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

Ahira@Num.1.15-=H0299.brief: Leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Exodus
Ahira@Num.1.15-=H0299.short: Ahira, son of Enan, was the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

Ahiram@Gen.46.21-1Ch=H0297.brief: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ahiramite clan
Ahiram@Gen.46.21-1Ch=H0297.short: Ahiram, also known as Aharah or Ehi, was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ahiramite clan.

Ahisamach@Exo.31.6-=H0294.brief: Father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan for the tabernacle
Ahisamach@Exo.31.6-=H0294.short: Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, was the father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan who helped construct the tabernacle.

Ahishahar@1Ch.7.10=H0300.short: Ahishahar was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

Ahishar@1Ki.4.6=H0301.short: Ahishar was in charge of King Solomon's palace.

Ahithophel@2Sa.15.12-1Ch=H0302.brief: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide
Ahithophel@2Sa.15.12-1Ch=H0302.short: Ahithophel was a wise counselor to David who defected to Absalom's side during Absalom's rebellion, but later committed suicide when his advice was not followed.

Ahitub@1Ch.6.11-Ezr=H0285I.brief: Ancestor of Ezra the scribe, in the priestly line
Ahitub@1Ch.6.11-Ezr=H0285I.short: Ahitub, son of Amariah and father of Zadok, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe in the priestly line.

Ahitub@1Sa.14.3-=H0285G.brief: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul
Ahitub@1Sa.14.3-=H0285G.short: Ahitub was the father of Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob who was killed by Saul for aiding David.

Ahitub@2Sa.8.17-1Ch=H0285H.brief: Father of Zadok the priest during David's reign
Ahitub@2Sa.8.17-1Ch=H0285H.short: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, who served as a priest alongside Abiathar during the reign of King David.

Ahlai@1Ch.11.41=H0304H.brief: Father of Zabad, one of David's mighty men
Ahlai@1Ch.11.41=H0304H.short: Ahlai was the father of Zabad, who was one of David's mighty men.

Ahlai@1Ch.2.31=H0304G.short: Ahlai was the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

Ahoah@2Sa.23.9-1Ch=H0265.brief: Descendant of Benjamin, clan of David's mighty men
Ahoah@2Sa.23.9-1Ch=H0265.short: The Ahohites, descendants of Ahoah of Benjamin, were a clan that included some of David's mighty men, such as Eleazar and Zalmon.

Ahumai@1Ch.4.2=H0267.short: Ahumai was a descendant of Judah through his grandson Reaiah.

Ahuzzam@1Ch.4.6=H0275.brief: Son of Ashhur and Naarah, a Judahite
Ahuzzam@1Ch.4.6=H0275.short: Ahuzzam was the son of Ashhur and his wife Naarah, from the tribe of Judah.

Ahuzzath@Gen.26.26=H0276.brief: Friend and advisor of Abimelech, Philistine king of Gerar
Ahuzzath@Gen.26.26=H0276.short: Ahuzzath was a friend and advisor of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied him when making a treaty with Isaac.

Aiah@2Sa.3.7-=H0345H.short: Aiah was the father of Rizpah, who was a concubine of King Saul.

Aiah@Gen.36.24-1Ch=H0345G.brief: Son of Zibeon the Hivite, brother of Anah
Aiah@Gen.36.24-1Ch=H0345G.short: Aiah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite and the brother of Anah, who was a descendant of Esau.

Akan@Gen.36.27-1Ch=H3292.brief: Son of Ezer, a Horite chief in Seir
Akan@Gen.36.27-1Ch=H3292.short: Akan was the son of Ezer, a Horite chief who lived in the land of Seir.

Akkub@1Ch.3.24=H6126G.brief: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
Akkub@1Ch.3.24=H6126G.short: Akkub was a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah, listed in the genealogy of the royal line.

Akkub@1Ch.9.17-Neh=H6126H.brief: Levite gatekeeper during the post-exilic period
Akkub@1Ch.9.17-Neh=H6126H.short: Akkub was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the Temple during the post-exilic period.

Akkub@Ezr.2.45=H6126I.brief: Family head of Temple servants who returned from exile
Akkub@Ezr.2.45=H6126I.short: Akkub was a family head of the Temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

Akkub@Neh.8.7=H6126J.brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
Akkub@Neh.8.7=H6126J.short: Akkub was a Levite who assisted Ezra in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading.

Alemeth@1Ch.7.8=H5964H.short: Alemeth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin.

Alemeth@1Ch.8.36-=H5964I.brief: Son of Jehoaddah, a Benjamite from Gibeon
Alemeth@1Ch.8.36-=H5964I.short: Alemeth was a son of Jehoaddah (or 'Jehoadah'), a Benjamite from Gibeon, and is listed in the genealogies of Saul's family.

Alexander@1Ti.1.20-2Ti=G0223J.brief: Opponent of Paul, along with Hymenaeus
Alexander@1Ti.1.20-2Ti=G0223J.short: Alexander, along with Hymenaeus, was an opponent of Paul's teaching and was handed over to Satan by Paul.

Alexander@Act.19.33=G0223I.brief: Jew put forward by the crowd in Ephesus
Alexander@Act.19.33=G0223I.short: Alexander was a Jew whom the crowd put forward during the riot in Ephesus, but they shouted him down when they realized he was a Jew.

Alexander@Act.4.6=G0223H.brief: Member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem
Alexander@Act.4.6=G0223H.short: Alexander was a member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem who was present during Peter and John's interrogation before the Sanhedrin.

Alexander@Mrk.15.21=G0223G.brief: Son of Simon who carried the cross
Alexander@Mrk.15.21=G0223G.short: Alexander was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross.

Allon@1Ch.4.37=H0438H.short: Allon was the son of Jedaiah, a descendant of Simeon.

Almodad@Gen.10.26-1Ch=H0486.brief: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
Almodad@Gen.10.26-1Ch=H0486.short: Almodad was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, listed in the genealogies of the nations.

Alphaeus@Mat.10.3-Act=G0256.brief: Father of apostles James and Matthew (Levi)
Alphaeus@Mat.10.3-Act=G0256.short: Alphaeus was the father of two of Jesus' apostles, James and Matthew (also known as Levi).

Alvah@Gen.36.40-1Ch=H5933.short: Alvah was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau through his son Eliphaz.

Alvan@Gen.36.23-1Ch=H5935.short: Alvan was a Horite chief, a descendant of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom before Esau's descendants.

Amal@1Ch.7.35=H6000.short: Amal was a son of Helem, a descendant of Asher, and is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

Amalek@Gen.36.12-=H6002H.brief: Grandson of Esau, ancestor of the Amalekites
Amalek@Gen.36.12-=H6002H.short: Amalek was the son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, and he became the ancestor of the Amalekite people.

Amariah@1Ch.23.19-=H0568I.brief: Levite, descendant of Hebron, during David's reign
Amariah@1Ch.23.19-=H0568I.short: Amariah was a Levite, a descendant of Hebron, who served during the reign of King David.

Amariah@1Ch.6.11-Ezr=H0568H.brief: High priest, ancestor of Ezra the scribe
Amariah@1Ch.6.11-Ezr=H0568H.short: Amariah was a high priest during the reign of Jehoshaphat and an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

Amariah@1Ch.6.7-=H0568G.brief: Ancestor of Zadok the priest, in Aaron's line
Amariah@1Ch.6.7-=H0568G.short: Amariah, son of Meraioth, was an ancestor of Zadok the priest and a descendant of Aaron through his son Eleazar.

Amariah@2Ch.19.11=H0568J.brief: Chief priest under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
Amariah@2Ch.19.11=H0568J.short: Amariah was the chief priest who assisted King Jehoshaphat in his judicial reforms in Judah.

Amariah@2Ch.31.15=H0568K.brief: Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah
Amariah@2Ch.31.15=H0568K.short: Amariah was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

Amariah@Ezr.10.42=H0568L.brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
Amariah@Ezr.10.42=H0568L.short: Amariah was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

Amariah@Neh.10.3-=H0568M.brief: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and served as chief priest
Amariah@Neh.10.3-=H0568M.short: Amariah was a priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and later served as a chief priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

Amariah@Neh.11.4=H0568N.short: Amariah, a descendant of Judah through Perez, was among those chosen to resettle in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

Amariah@Zep.1.1=H0568O.short: Amariah was an ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet, who prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

Amasa@2Ch.28.12=H6021H.brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed enslaving Judahite captives
Amasa@2Ch.28.12=H6021H.short: Amasa, along with other leaders of Ephraim, opposed the Israelite army's attempt to bring Judahite captives as slaves to Samaria.

Amasa@2Sa.17.25-1Ch=H6021G.brief: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab
Amasa@2Sa.17.25-1Ch=H6021G.short: Amasa, the son of Jether and Abigail (David's sister), was a military commander who served under Absalom and later David, but was killed by Joab.

Amasai@1Ch.12.18=H6022H.brief: Chief of thirty who joined David
Amasai@1Ch.12.18=H6022H.short: Amasai, a chief of thirty mighty men, joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

Amasai@1Ch.15.24=H6022I.short: Amasai, a priest, was among those who blew the trumpet when the Ark of the Covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

Amasai@1Ch.6.25-=H6022G.short: Amasai, a Levite descended from Kohath, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

Amasai@2Ch.29.12=H6022J.brief: Levite who helped purify the temple
Amasai@2Ch.29.12=H6022J.short: Amasai, a Levite of the sons of Merari, helped purify the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

Amasiah@2Ch.17.16=H6007.brief: Commander who volunteered for God's service
Amasiah@2Ch.17.16=H6007.short: Amasiah, the son of Zichri, was a commander who willingly offered himself for the service of the Lord during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

Amaziah@1Ch.4.34=H0558H.short: Amaziah, the son of Joshah, was a descendant of Simeon.

Amaziah@1Ch.6.45=H0558I.short: Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah, was a Levite of the family of Merari during the time of David.

Amaziah@2Ki.12.21-2Ch=H0558G.brief: King of Judah, son of Joash
Amaziah@2Ki.12.21-2Ch=H0558G.short: Amaziah, son of Joash, was the ninth king of Judah who reigned for 29 years.

Amaziah@Amo.7.10-=H0558J.brief: Priest of Bethel during Amos' ministry
Amaziah@Amo.7.10-=H0558J.short: Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, opposed the prophet Amos and told him to leave the kingdom of Israel.

Ami@Ezr.2.57-Neh=H0532.short: The descendants of Ami (or Amon) were among the returned exiles who were servants of Solomon.

Amittai@2Ki.14.25-Jon=H0573.short: Amittai was the father of Jonah, the prophet from Gath-hepher.

Ammiel@1Ch.26.5=H5988I.short: Ammiel was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

Ammiel@2Sa.9.4-=H5988H.short: Ammiel was the father of Machir, who provided assistance to David during his flight from Absalom.

Ammiel@Num.13.12=H5988G.brief: Spy from the tribe of Dan
Ammiel@Num.13.12=H5988G.short: Ammiel, the son of Gemalli, was the representative from the tribe of Dan among the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

Ammihud@1Ch.9.4=H5989K.brief: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
Ammihud@1Ch.9.4=H5989K.short: Ammihud, a descendant of Judah, was among those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

Ammihud@2Sa.13.37=H5989J.brief: Father of Talmai, king of Geshur
Ammihud@2Sa.13.37=H5989J.short: Ammihud (or Ammihur) was the father of Talmai, the king of Geshur, to whom Absalom fled after killing his brother Amnon.

Ammihud@Num.1.10-1Ch=H5989G.brief: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim
Ammihud@Num.1.10-1Ch=H5989G.short: Ammihud was the father of Elishama, the leader of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness journey.

Ammihud@Num.34.20=H5989H.brief: Father of Shemuel, leader from Simeon
Ammihud@Num.34.20=H5989H.short: Ammihud was the father of Shemuel, the leader from the tribe of Simeon appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

Ammihud@Num.34.28=H5989I.brief: Father of Pedahel, leader from Naphtali
Ammihud@Num.34.28=H5989I.short: Ammihud was the father of Pedahel, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

Amminadab@1Ch.15.10-=H5992H.brief: Levite leader during the Ark's transfer
Amminadab@1Ch.15.10-=H5992H.short: Amminadab was a Levite leader from the Uzzielite clan who participated in the transfer of the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem.

Amminadab@Exo.6.23-Luk=H5992G.brief: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David
Amminadab@Exo.6.23-Luk=H5992G.short: Amminadab was the father of Elisheba, who married Aaron, and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

Amminadib@Sng.6.12=H5993.brief: Noble mentioned in a love song
Amminadib@Sng.6.12=H5993.short: Amminadib is mentioned in a poetic passage in the Song of Solomon, possibly referring to a noble or prince.

Ammishaddai@Num.1.12-=H5996.brief: Father of Ahiezer, leader of Dan
Ammishaddai@Num.1.12-=H5996.short: Ammishaddai was the father of Ahiezer, the leader of the tribe of Dan during the wilderness journey.

Ammizabad@1Ch.27.6=H5990.brief: Son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men
Ammizabad@1Ch.27.6=H5990.short: Ammizabad was the son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men, and served as his father's second-in-command.

Amnon@1Ch.4.20=H0550H.brief: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah
Amnon@1Ch.4.20=H0550H.short: Amnon was a son of Shimon and a descendant of Judah.

Amnon@2Sa.3.2-1Ch=H0550G.brief: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom
Amnon@2Sa.3.2-1Ch=H0550G.short: Amnon, David's firstborn son, raped his half-sister Tamar and was later killed by her brother Absalom.

Amok@Neh.12.7-=H5987.brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
Amok@Neh.12.7-=H5987.short: Amok was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and signed the covenant under Nehemiah.

Amon@1Ki.22.26-2Ch=H0526G.brief: Governor of Samaria during Ahab's reign
Amon@1Ki.22.26-2Ch=H0526G.short: Amon was the governor of Samaria during the reign of King Ahab of Israel.

Amon@2Ki.21.18-Mat=H0526H.brief: King of Judah, son of Manasseh
Amon@2Ki.21.18-Mat=H0526H.short: Amon, the son of Manasseh, was the 15th king of Judah who reigned for two years before being assassinated by his servants.

Amorites@Gen.10.16-Amo=H0567.brief: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel
Amorites@Gen.10.16-Amo=H0567.short: The Amorites were a Canaanite people group who lived in the hill country and were among the enemies the Israelites faced when entering the Promised Land.

Amos@Amo.1.1-=H5986.brief: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel
Amos@Amo.1.1-=H5986.short: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, called by God as a prophet to Israel.

Amos@Luk.3.25=G0301G.brief: Son of Naum in Jesus' genealogy
Amos@Luk.3.25=G0301G.short: Amos, an ancestor of Jesus, son of Naum.

Amoz@2Ki.19.2-Isa=H0531.short: Amoz, the father of the prophet Isaiah.

Ampliatus@Rom.16.8=G0291.brief: Believer greeted by Paul in Rome
Ampliatus@Rom.16.8=G0291.short: Ampliatus, a beloved fellow believer greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

Amram@Exo.6.18-1Ch=H6019G.brief: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
Amram@Exo.6.18-1Ch=H6019G.short: Amram was the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, and a member of the tribe of Levi.

Amram@Ezr.10.34=H6019H.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
Amram@Ezr.10.34=H6019H.short: Amram was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the Exile and agreed to put her away.

Amraphel@Gen.14.1-=H0569.brief: King of Shinar, ally of Chedorlaomer
Amraphel@Gen.14.1-=H0569.short: Amraphel, king of Shinar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the Plain.

Amzi@1Ch.6.46=H0557G.short: Amzi, a descendant of Merari, was a Levite who served as a musician in the temple.

Amzi@Neh.11.12=H0557H.brief: Priest in Jerusalem after the Exile
Amzi@Neh.11.12=H0557H.short: Amzi was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

Anah@Gen.36.2-1Ch=H6034.brief: Horite, father of Oholibamah, Esau's wife
Anah@Gen.36.2-1Ch=H6034.short: Anah was a Horite, the father of Oholibamah, one of Esau's wives, and the discoverer of hot springs in the wilderness.

Anaiah@Neh.10.22=H6043H.short: Anaiah was a priest who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during Nehemiah's time.

Anaiah@Neh.8.4=H6043G.brief: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
Anaiah@Neh.8.4=H6043G.short: Anaiah was one of the men who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

Anak@Num.13.22-Jdg=H6061.brief: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan
Anak@Num.13.22-Jdg=H6061.short: Anak was the ancestor of the Anakim, a race of giants who inhabited Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

Anamim@Gen.10.13-1Ch=H6047.brief: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
Anamim@Gen.10.13-1Ch=H6047.short: The Anamim were a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, and are listed among the nations in the Table of Nations.

Anammelech@2Ki.17.31=H6048.short: Anammelech was an Assyrian deity worshiped by the Sepharvites, who were among the foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king.

Anan@Neh.10.26=H6052.brief: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
Anan@Neh.10.26=H6052.short: Anan was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

Anani@1Ch.3.24=H6054.short: Anani was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

Ananiah@Neh.3.23=H6055G.brief: Repairer of the wall in Jerusalem
Ananiah@Neh.3.23=H6055G.short: Ananiah made repairs to a section of the wall near his house during the rebuilding of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

Ananias@Act.23.2-=G0367I.short: Ananias, the high priest, presided over Paul's trial and ordered him to be struck on the mouth for his defense.

Ananias@Act.5.1-=G0367G.brief: Husband of Sapphira, lied about offering proceeds
Ananias@Act.5.1-=G0367G.short: Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from the sale of their property and faced divine judgment.

Ananias@Act.9.10-=G0367H.short: Ananias, a disciple in Damascus, was sent by God to heal and baptize Saul (later known as Paul) after his conversion on the road to Damascus.

Anath@Jdg.3.31-=H6067.brief: Father of Shamgar, a judge of Israel
Anath@Jdg.3.31-=H6067.short: Anath was the father of Shamgar, one of the judges who delivered Israel from oppression.

Anathoth@1Ch.7.8=H6068H.brief: Son of Becher, descendant of Benjamin
Anathoth@1Ch.7.8=H6068H.short: Anathoth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

Anathoth@Neh.10.19=H6068I.brief: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
Anathoth@Neh.10.19=H6068I.short: Anathoth was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

Andrew@Mat.4.18-Act=G0406.short: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ and played a significant role in the early church.

Andronicus@Rom.16.7=G0408.brief: Fellow prisoner with Paul, outstanding among the apostles
Andronicus@Rom.16.7=G0408.short: Andronicus, along with Junia, was a fellow prisoner with Paul and was noted as outstanding among the apostles.

Aner@Gen.14.13-=H6063G.short: Aner was an Amorite, one of the allies of Abram, who joined him in the battle against the kings who had taken Lot captive.

Aniam@1Ch.7.19=H0593.brief: Son of Shemida, descendant of Manasseh
Aniam@1Ch.7.19=H0593.short: Aniam was a son of Shemida and a descendant of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

Anna@Luk.2.36=G0451.brief: Prophetess who witnessed Jesus' dedication in the temple
Anna@Luk.2.36=G0451.short: Anna, a prophetess and widow, witnessed the dedication of the infant Jesus in the temple and spoke about Him to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

Annas@Luk.3.2-Act=G0452.brief: High priest during Jesus' ministry and trial
Annas@Luk.3.2-Act=G0452.short: Annas, a high priest, played a significant role in the events surrounding Jesus' arrest, trial, and crucifixion, as well as in the early persecution of the apostles.

Anthothijah@1Ch.8.24=H6070.brief: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
Anthothijah@1Ch.8.24=H6070.short: Anthothijah was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

Antipas@Rev.2.13=G0493.short: Antipas, described as Christ's faithful witness, was martyred in Pergamum, where Satan's throne was said to be.

Anub@1Ch.4.8=H6036.brief: Son of Coz, descendant of Judah
Anub@1Ch.4.8=H6036.short: Anub was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

Apelles@Rom.16.10=G0559.brief: Approved in Christ, greeted by Paul
Apelles@Rom.16.10=G0559.short: Apelles, described as "approved in Christ," was among those greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

Aphiah@1Sa.9.1=H0647.brief: Ancestor of King Saul, a Benjamite
Aphiah@1Sa.9.1=H0647.short: Aphiah, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul, the first king of Israel.

Apollos@Act.18.24-Tit=G0625.brief: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul
Apollos@Act.18.24-Tit=G0625.short: Apollos, an eloquent and learned Jewish Christian from Alexandria, was an important figure in the early church who worked alongside Paul in spreading the gospel.

Appaim@1Ch.2.30-=H0649.brief: Son of Nadab, descendant of Judah
Appaim@1Ch.2.30-=H0649.short: Appaim was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

Apphia@Phm.1.2=G0682.brief: Recipient of Paul's letter to Philemon
Apphia@Phm.1.2=G0682.short: Apphia, likely a member of Philemon's household, was one of the recipients of Paul's letter to Philemon.

Aquila@Act.18.2-2Ti=G0207.brief: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul
Aquila@Act.18.2-2Ti=G0207.short: Aquila, along with his wife Priscilla, was a Jewish Christian who worked as a tentmaker and played a significant role in the early church, partnering with Paul in his ministry.

Ara@1Ch.7.38=H0690.brief: Son of Jether, descendant of Asher
Ara@1Ch.7.38=H0690.short: Ara was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

Arad@1Ch.8.15=H6166B.short: Arad was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Beriah.

Arah@1Ch.7.39=H0733G.short: Arah, the son of Shual ('Ulla'), was a descendant of Asher.

Arah@Ezr.2.5-Neh=H0733H.short: Arah, whose daughter was married to Shechaniah, was the father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite.

Arah@Neh.6.18=H0733I.brief: A Jewish leader whose daughter married Tobiah's son.
Arah@Neh.6.18=H0733I.short: Arah's daughter was married to the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

Aram@1Ch.7.34=H0758J.brief: Son of Shemer, descendant of Asher
Aram@1Ch.7.34=H0758J.short: Aram was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

Aram@Gen.10.22-1Ch=H0758G.brief: Son of Shem, ancestor of the Arameans
Aram@Gen.10.22-1Ch=H0758G.short: Aram, a son of Shem and ancestor of the Aramean people.

Aram@Gen.22.21=H0758H.brief: Son of Kemuel, nephew of Abraham
Aram@Gen.22.21=H0758H.short: Aram was the son of Kemuel, who was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor.

Aramitess@1Ch.7.14=H0761G.brief: Concubine of Manasseh; mother of Asriel
Aramitess@1Ch.7.14=H0761G.short: An Aramitess, who was a concubine of Manasseh, gave birth to Machir and Asriel..

Aran@Gen.36.28-1Ch=H0765.brief: Son of Dishan, descendant of Seir the Horite
Aran@Gen.36.28-1Ch=H0765.short: Aran was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau's family and the Horite clans.

Arba@Jos.14.15-=H0704.brief: Father of Anak, former name of Hebron
Arba@Jos.14.15-=H0704.short: Arba was the father of Anak and the namesake of Kiriath-arba, which was the former name of Hebron.

Archelaus@Mat.2.22=G0745.brief: Son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch of Judea
Archelaus@Mat.2.22=G0745.short: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch over Judea, causing Joseph to fear returning there with Mary and the child Jesus.

Archippus@Col.4.17-Phm=G0751.brief: Fellow soldier and minister in Colossae
Archippus@Col.4.17-Phm=G0751.short: Archippus, addressed as a fellow soldier by Paul, was urged to complete the ministry he had received in the Lord.

Archites@Jos.16.2-1Ch=H0757.brief: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel
Archites@Jos.16.2-1Ch=H0757.short: The Archites were a people group mentioned in relation to the boundaries of Ephraim's territory and as the origin of Hushai, King David's friend and advisor.

Ard@Gen.46.21=H0714G.brief: Son of Benjamin, brother of Bela
Ard@Gen.46.21=H0714G.short: Ard, a son of Benjamin, is listed among the descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt during the famine.

Ard@Num.26.40=H0714H.brief: Grandson of Benjamin, son of Bela
Ard@Num.26.40=H0714H.short: Ard, a grandson of Benjamin, is mentioned in the census of the Israelites taken in the wilderness of Moab.

Ardon@1Ch.2.18=H0715.brief: Son of Caleb, brother of Jether and Mered
Ardon@1Ch.2.18=H0715.short: Ardon was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

Areli@Gen.46.16-Num=H0692.brief: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob
Areli@Gen.46.16-Num=H0692.short: Areli, a son of Gad, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jacob and the census of the Israelites in the wilderness.

Aretas@2Co.11.32=G0702.brief: King of the Nabataeans in Damascus
Aretas@2Co.11.32=G0702.short: Aretas, the king of the Nabataeans, governed Damascus and tried to arrest Paul.

Argob@2Ki.15.25=H0709H.brief: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
Argob@2Ki.15.25=H0709H.short: Argob, along with Arieh, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

Aridai@Est.9.9=H0742.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
Aridai@Est.9.9=H0742.short: Aridai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

Aridatha@Est.9.8=H0743.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
Aridatha@Est.9.8=H0743.short: Aridatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

Arieh@2Ki.15.25=H0745.brief: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
Arieh@2Ki.15.25=H0745.short: Arieh, along with Argob, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

Ariel@2Sa.23.20-1Ch=H0739.brief: Two lion-like men of Moab killed by Benaiah
Ariel@2Sa.23.20-1Ch=H0739.short: Ariel refers to two lion-like men of Moab who were killed by Benaiah, one of David's mighty warriors.

Ariel@Ezr.8.16=H0740G.brief: One of the leaders summoned by Ezra
Ariel@Ezr.8.16=H0740G.short: Ariel was one of the leaders summoned by Ezra to assist in the return of the exiles to Jerusalem.

Arioch@Dan.2.14-=H0746B.short: Arioch, the captain of King Nebuchadnezzar's guard, was commanded to execute the wise men of Babylon but brought Daniel before the king to interpret his dream.

Arioch@Gen.14.1-=H0746A.brief: King of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer
Arioch@Gen.14.1-=H0746A.short: Arioch, king of Ellasar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

Arisai@Est.9.9=H0747.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
Arisai@Est.9.9=H0747.short: Arisai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

Aristarchus@Act.19.29-Phm=G0708.brief: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner
Aristarchus@Act.19.29-Phm=G0708.short: Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was a faithful companion of Paul during his missionary journeys and imprisonment.

Aristobulus@Rom.16.10=G0711.brief: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul
Aristobulus@Rom.16.10=G0711.short: Paul sends greetings to those who belong to the household of Aristobulus, suggesting that Aristobulus was a prominent believer in Rome.

Arkites@Gen.10.17-1Ch=H6208.brief: Canaanite people group descended from Canaan
Arkites@Gen.10.17-1Ch=H6208.short: The Arkites were one of the Canaanite tribes descended from Canaan, the son of Ham, and are mentioned in the Table of Nations.

Armoni@2Sa.21.8=H0764.brief: Son of Saul by Rizpah, killed by Gibeonites
Armoni@2Sa.21.8=H0764.short: Armoni was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah, killed by the Gibeonites (2Sa.21.8).

Arnan@1Ch.3.21=H0770.short: Arnan was a descendant of David's son Solomon (1Ch.3.21).

Arod@Gen.46.16-Num=H0720.brief: Son of Gad and founder of the Arodite clan
Arod@Gen.46.16-Num=H0720.short: Arod, son of Gad, was the founder of the Arodite clan (Gen.46.16; Num.26.17).

Arpachshad@Gen.10.22-Luk=H0775.brief: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
Arpachshad@Gen.10.22-Luk=H0775.short: Arpachshad, son of Shem, was born two years after the flood and was an ancestor of Abraham (Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36).

Artaxerxes@Ezr.4.7-Neh=H0783A.brief: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time
Artaxerxes@Ezr.4.7-Neh=H0783A.short: Artaxerxes was the Persian king who allowed Ezra and Nehemiah to return to Jerusalem (Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14).

Artemas@Tit.3.12=G0734.brief: Companion of Paul, potential replacement for Titus
Artemas@Tit.3.12=G0734.short: Artemas was a companion of Paul who could potentially replace Titus in Crete (Titus 3:12).

Arvadites@Gen.10.18-1Ch=H0721.brief: Canaanite descendants of Canaan, son of Ham
Arvadites@Gen.10.18-1Ch=H0721.short: The Arvadites were a Canaanite People from Canaan, son of Ham (Gen.10.18; 1Ch.1.16).

Arza@1Ki.16.9=H0777.brief: Steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah
Arza@1Ki.16.9=H0777.short: Arza was the steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah (1Ki.16.9).

Asa@1Ch.9.16=H0609H.brief: Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem
Asa@1Ch.9.16=H0609H.short: Asa was a Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem (1Ch.9.16).

Asa@1Ki.15.8-Mat=H0609G.brief: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat
Asa@1Ki.15.8-Mat=H0609G.short: Asa was a king of Judah who reigned for 41 years, known for his religious reforms (1Kings 15; 2Chr 14-16).

Asahel@2Ch.17.8=H6214H.brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
Asahel@2Ch.17.8=H6214H.short: Asahel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah (2Ch.17.8).

Asahel@2Ch.31.13=H6214I.brief: Levite in charge of tithes under Hezekiah
Asahel@2Ch.31.13=H6214I.short: Asahel was a Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute the tithes and dedicated things (2Ch.31.13).

Asahel@2Sa.2.18-1Ch=H6214G.brief: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner
Asahel@2Sa.2.18-1Ch=H6214G.short: Asahel, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was a fast runner killed by Abner during a battle (2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7).

Asahel@Ezr.10.15=H6214J.brief: Opposed Ezra's dissolution of mixed marriages
Asahel@Ezr.10.15=H6214J.short: Asahel, along with Jahzeiah, opposed Ezra's plan to dissolve mixed marriages among the returned exiles (Ezra 10:15).

Asaiah@1Ch.15.6-=H6222K.brief: Levite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
Asaiah@1Ch.15.6-=H6222K.short: Asaiah was a Levite leader who assisted in bringing the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem during David's reign (1Ch.15.6, 11).

Asaiah@1Ch.4.36=H6222H.short: Asaiah was a Simeonite leader during the reign of King Hezekiah (1Ch.4.36).

Asaiah@1Ch.6.30=H6222I.brief: Merarite Levite, ancestor of Ethan the singer
Asaiah@1Ch.6.30=H6222I.short: Asaiah was a Merarite Levite, an ancestor of Ethan the singer (1Ch.6.30).

Asaiah@1Ch.9.5=H6222J.brief: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
Asaiah@1Ch.9.5=H6222J.short: Asaiah, a descendant of Judah, lived in Jerusalem (1Ch.9.5).

Asaiah@2Ki.22.12-2Ch=H6222G.brief: Servant of King Josiah during Book of Law discovery
Asaiah@2Ki.22.12-2Ch=H6222G.short: Asaiah was a servant of King Josiah sent to consult the prophetess Huldah about the Book of the Law (2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20).

Asaph@1Ch.6.39-Psa=H0623G.brief: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers
Asaph@1Ch.6.39-Psa=H0623G.short: Asaph was a Levite musician and psalmist during David's reign, and his descendants served as temple singers (1Ch.6.39; 15:17, 19; 16:5, 7, 37; 25:1, 2, 6, 9; 2Ch.5.12; 20:14; 29:13, 30; 35:15; Ezra 2:41; 3:10; Neh.7.44; 11:22; 12:35, 46; Psalms 50, 73-83).

Asaph@1Ch.9.15-Neh=H0623I.brief: Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem
Asaph@1Ch.9.15-Neh=H0623I.short: Asaph was a Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17).

Asaph@2Ki.18.18-Isa=H0623H.short: Asaph served as the recorder during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah (2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22).

Asaph@Neh.2.8=H0623J.brief: Keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time
Asaph@Neh.2.8=H0623J.short: Asaph was the keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time (Neh.2.8).

Asarel@1Ch.4.16=H0840.brief: Son of Jehallelel, from the tribe of Judah
Asarel@1Ch.4.16=H0840.short: Asarel was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah (1Ch.4.16).

Asen@Neh.7.24=G9825.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
Asen@Neh.7.24=G9825.short: Asen was an ancestor of 223 individuals who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

Asenath@Gen.41.45-=H0621.brief: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim
Asenath@Gen.41.45-=H0621.short: Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, was given to Joseph as his wife by Pharaoh (Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20).

Asharelah@1Ch.25.2-=H0841.brief: Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres
Asharelah@1Ch.25.2-=H0841.short: Asharelah (or Jesharelah) was a Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres (1Ch.25.2, 14).

Ashbel@Gen.46.21-1Ch=H0788.brief: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ashbelite clan
Ashbel@Gen.46.21-1Ch=H0788.short: Ashbel was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ashbelite clan (Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1).

Asher@Gen.30.13-Rev=H0836.brief: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher
Asher@Gen.30.13-Rev=H0836.short: Asher was the eighth son of Jacob, born to Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, and became the founder of the tribe of Asher (Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36).

Ashhur@1Ch.2.24-=H0806.short: Ashhur, a descendant of Judah through Hezron, was the father (ie founder) of Tekoa (1Ch.2.24; 4:5).

Ashkenaz@Gen.10.3-1Ch=H0813G.brief: Grandson of Japheth, son of Gomer
Ashkenaz@Gen.10.3-1Ch=H0813G.short: Ashkenaz was a grandson of Japheth and son of Gomer, mentioned in the Table of Nations (Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6).

Ashpenaz@Dan.1.3=H0828.short: Ashpenaz was the chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court, responsible for selecting and training young Israelite exiles (Dan.1.3).

Ashvath@1Ch.7.33=H6220.brief: Son of Japhlet, descendant of Asher
Ashvath@1Ch.7.33=H6220.short: Ashvath was a son of Japhlet and a descendant of Asher (1Ch.7.33).

Asiel@1Ch.4.35=H6221.short: Asiel was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe (1Ch.4.35).

Asnah@Ezr.2.50=H0619.brief: Head of a family of temple servants who returned from exile
Asnah@Ezr.2.50=H0619.short: Asnah was the head of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile (Ezra 2:50).

Aspatha@Est.9.7=H0630.brief: One of the ten sons of Haman
Aspatha@Est.9.7=H0630.short: Aspatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were executed after their father's downfall (Est.9.7).

Asriel@1Ch.7.14=H0844H.brief: Son of Gilead, descendant of Manasseh
Asriel@1Ch.7.14=H0844H.short: Asriel was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh (1Ch.7.14).

Asriel@Num.26.31-Jos=H0844G.brief: Son of Manasseh, founder of the Asrielite clan
Asriel@Num.26.31-Jos=H0844G.short: Asriel was a son of Manasseh and the founder of the Asrielite clan (Num.26.31; Josh 17:2).

Asshur@Gen.10.22-1Ch=H0804H.brief: Son of Shem; father of the Assyrians
Asshur@Gen.10.22-1Ch=H0804H.short: Asshur was a son of Shem and is considered the father of the Assyrians (Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17).

Asshurim@Gen.25.3=H0805A.short: Asshurim was a descendant of Abraham through his son Jokshan and grandson Dedan (Gen.25.3).

Assir@1Ch.6.23-=H0617H.brief: Levite ancestor of the prophet Samuel
Assir@1Ch.6.23-=H0617H.short: Assir was a Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet (1Ch.6.23, 37).

Assir@Exo.6.24-1Ch=H0617G.brief: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath
Assir@Exo.6.24-1Ch=H0617G.short: Assir was a son of Korah and great-grandson of Kohath, from the tribe of Levi (Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22).

Asyncritus@Rom.16.14=G0799.brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
Asyncritus@Rom.16.14=G0799.short: Asyncritus was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings (Rom.16.14).

Atarah@1Ch.2.26=H5851.brief: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Onam
Atarah@1Ch.2.26=H5851.short: Atarah was the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah (1Ch.2.26).

Ater@Ezr.2.16-Neh=H0333G.brief: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
Ater@Ezr.2.16-Neh=H0333G.short: Ater was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21).

Ater@Ezr.2.42-Neh=H0333H.brief: Head of a family of gatekeepers who returned from exile
Ater@Ezr.2.42-Neh=H0333H.short: Ater was the head of a family of gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45).

Ater@Neh.10.17=H0333I.brief: One of the signers of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
Ater@Neh.10.17=H0333I.short: Ater was one of the individuals who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah's reforms (Neh.10.17).

Athaiah@Neh.11.4=H6265.brief: Descendant of Judah who resettled in Jerusalem
Athaiah@Neh.11.4=H6265.short: Athaiah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the people who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (Neh.11.4).

Athaliah@1Ch.8.26=H6271H.short: Athaliah was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of Saul's family (1Ch.8.26).

Athaliah@2Ki.8.26-2Ch=H6271G.brief: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel
Athaliah@2Ki.8.26-2Ch=H6271G.short: Athaliah, the daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, became queen of Judah and ruled for six years before being overthrown (2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7).

Athaliah@Ezr.8.7=H6271I.brief: Descendant of Elam who returned from Babylonian exile
Athaliah@Ezr.8.7=H6271I.short: Athaliah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra (Ezr.8.7).

Athlai@Ezr.10.28=H6270.brief: One of those who agreed to put away foreign wives
Athlai@Ezr.10.28=H6270.short: Athlai was one of the men who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms (Ezr.10.28).

Attai@1Ch.12.11=H6262H.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior
Attai@1Ch.12.11=H6262H.short: Attai the son of Zabad was one of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior who joined him at Ziklag (1Ch.12.11).

Attai@1Ch.2.35-=H6262G.brief: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah
Attai@1Ch.2.35-=H6262G.short: Attai was the grandson of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah (1Ch.2.35-36).

Attai@2Ch.11.20=H6262I.brief: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
Attai@2Ch.11.20=H6262I.short: Attai was a son of King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah (2Ch.11.20).

Augustus@Luk.2.1-Act=G0828.brief: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus
Augustus@Luk.2.1-Act=G0828.short: Augustus, also known as Caesar, was the Roman emperor during the time of Jesus' birth and early life (Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1).

Avvim@Deu.2.23-Jos=H5761G.brief: Ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area
Avvim@Deu.2.23-Jos=H5761G.short: The Avvim were an ancient people who inhabited the Gaza area before being destroyed by the Caphtorim (Deut 2:23; Josh 13:3).

Azaliah@2Ki.22.3-2Ch=H0683.brief: Father of Shaphan the scribe during Josiah's reign
Azaliah@2Ki.22.3-2Ch=H0683.short: Azaliah was the father of Shaphan the scribe, who served during the reign of King Josiah of Judah (2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8).

Azaniah@Neh.10.9=H0245.brief: One of the Levites who sealed the covenant
Azaniah@Neh.10.9=H0245.short: Azaniah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (Neh.10.9).

Azarel@1Ch.12.6=H5832G.brief: One of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag
Azarel@1Ch.12.6=H5832G.short: Azarel was one of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag (1Ch.12.6).

Azarel@1Ch.27.22=H5832H.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
Azarel@1Ch.27.22=H5832H.short: Azarel son of Jeroham was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign (1Ch.27.22).

Azarel@Ezr.10.41=H5832I.brief: One of those who married foreign women during Ezra's time
Azarel@Ezr.10.41=H5832I.short: Azarel was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (Ezr.10.41).

Azarel@Neh.12.36=H5832J.brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
Azarel@Neh.12.36=H5832J.short: Azarel was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (Neh.12.36).

Azariah@1Ch.2.38-=H5838J.brief: Descendant of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron
Azariah@1Ch.2.38-=H5838J.short: Azariah was a descendant of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah (1Ch.2.38, 39).

Azariah@1Ch.2.8=H5838I.brief: Son of Ethan, descendant of Judah
Azariah@1Ch.2.8=H5838I.short: Azariah was the son of Ethan, a descendant of Judah (1Ch.2.8).

Azariah@1Ch.6.13-Ezr=H5838L.brief: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests
Azariah@1Ch.6.13-Ezr=H5838L.short: Azariah was father of Seraiah, father of Ezra. His ancestors served as high priests (1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1).

Azariah@1Ch.6.9-Ezr=H5838K.brief: Descendant of Zadok, a priest before Solomon's reign
Azariah@1Ch.6.9-Ezr=H5838K.short: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, was a priest before the reign of King Solomon (1Ki.4.2; 1Ch.6.9).

Azariah@1Ki.4.2-1Ch=H5838G.brief: High priest during Solomon's reign, descendant of Zadok
Azariah@1Ki.4.2-1Ch=H5838G.short: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, served as high priest during the reign of King Solomon (1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3).

Azariah@1Ki.4.5=H5838H.brief: Son of Nathan, an official in Solomon's court
Azariah@1Ki.4.5=H5838H.short: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was an official in King Solomon's court (1Ki.4.5).

Azariah@2Ch.15.1=H5838M.brief: Prophet who encouraged King Asa to seek God
Azariah@2Ch.15.1=H5838M.short: Azariah, the son of Oded, was a prophet who encouraged King Asa of Judah to seek God (2Ch.15.1).

Azariah@2Ch.21.2=H5838Q.brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
Azariah@2Ch.21.2=H5838Q.short: Azariah was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (2Ch.21.2).

Azariah@2Ch.23.1a=H5838S.brief: A commander who helped crown Joash king
Azariah@2Ch.23.1a=H5838S.short: Azariah son of Jeroham was a military commander who supported Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne of Judah.

Azariah@2Ch.23.1b=H5838T.brief: A commander who supported Joash's coronation
Azariah@2Ch.23.1b=H5838T.short: Azariah son of Obed was one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

Azariah@2Ch.26.17-=H5838N.brief: High priest who confronted King Uzziah
Azariah@2Ch.26.17-=H5838N.short: Azariah, the high priest, confronted King Uzziah when he attempted to burn incense in the temple (2Ch.26.17, 20).

Azariah@2Ch.28.12=H5838O.brief: Leader who opposed the enslaving of captives

Azariah@2Ch.29.12a=H5838U.brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
Azariah@2Ch.29.12a=H5838U.short: Azariah son of Jehallel was a Merarite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

Azariah@2Ch.29.12b=H5838V.short: Azariah son of Jehallelel was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

Azariah@Dan.1.6-=H5838Z.short: Azariah, also known as Abednego, was one of Daniel's companions who survived the fiery furnace (Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3).

Azariah@Neh.3.23-=H5838W.brief: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall

Azariah@Neh.7.7-=H5838X.brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
Azariah@Neh.7.7-=H5838X.short: Azariah was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33).

Azariah@Neh.8.7=H5838Y.brief: Levite who helped the people understand the Law
Azariah@Neh.8.7=H5838Y.short: Azariah was a Levite who helped the people understand the Law during the time of Ezra (Neh.8.7).

Azariahu@2Ch.21.2=H5838R.brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
Azariahu@2Ch.21.2=H5838R.short: Azariahu was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (2Ch.21.2).

Azaz@1Ch.5.8=H5811.brief: Descendant of Reuben; father of Bela
Azaz@1Ch.5.8=H5811.short: Azaz, a descendant of Reuben, was the father of Bela (1Ch.5.8).

Azaziah@1Ch.27.20=H5812H.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
Azaziah@1Ch.27.20=H5812H.short: Azaziah was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King David (1Ch.27.20).

Azaziah@2Ch.31.13=H5812I.brief: Levite during Hezekiah's reign, in charge of offerings
Azaziah@2Ch.31.13=H5812I.short: Azaziah was a Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah, appointed to oversee the freewill offerings (2Ch.31.13).

Azbuk@Neh.3.16=H5802.brief: Father of Nehemiah, who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
Azbuk@Neh.3.16=H5802.short: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David (Neh.3.16).

Azel@1Ch.8.37-=H0682A.short: Azel, a descendant of Saul, had six sons: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan (1Ch.8.37, 38; 9:43, 44).

Azgad@Ezr.2.12-Neh=H5803G.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
Azgad@Ezr.2.12-Neh=H5803G.short: Azgad was the ancestor of 1,222 (or 2,322) exiles who returned to Jerusalem (Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17).

Azgad@Neh.10.15=H5803H.brief: Leader who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
Azgad@Neh.10.15=H5803H.short: Azgad was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (Neh.10.15).

Aziza@Ezr.10.27=H5819.brief: Descendant of Zattu, had married a foreign woman
Aziza@Ezr.10.27=H5819.short: Aziza, a descendant of Zattu, was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (Ezr.10.27).

Azmaveth@1Ch.12.3=H5820I.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
Azmaveth@1Ch.12.3=H5820I.short: Azmaveth, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul (1Ch.12.3).

Azmaveth@1Ch.27.25=H5820J.brief: Overseer of royal treasuries under King David
Azmaveth@1Ch.27.25=H5820J.short: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of King David's treasuries (1Ch.27.25).

Azmaveth@1Ch.8.36-=H5820H.brief: Descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah
Azmaveth@1Ch.8.36-=H5820H.short: Azmaveth, a descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah..

Azmaveth@2Sa.23.31-1Ch=H5820G.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Barhumite
Azmaveth@2Sa.23.31-1Ch=H5820G.short: Azmaveth the Barhumite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor (2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33).

Azor@Mat.1.13-=G0107.brief: Ancestor of Jesus Christ in the genealogy of Matthew
Azor@Mat.1.13-=G0107.short: Azor was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Matthew (Matt 1:13, 14).

Azriel@1Ch.27.19=H5837H.brief: Ruler of the tribe of Naphtali under David
Azriel@1Ch.27.19=H5837H.short: Azriel son of Jeremoth was the ruler of the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David (1Ch.27.19).

Azriel@1Ch.5.24=H5837G.brief: Head of a half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead
Azriel@1Ch.5.24=H5837G.short: Azriel was a head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead (1Ch.5.24).

Azriel@Jer.36.26=H5837I.short: Azriel was one of the officials sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest the prophet Jeremiah (Jer.36.26).

Azrikam@1Ch.3.23=H5840G.brief: A descendant of David through Jehoiachin.
Azrikam@1Ch.3.23=H5840G.short: Azrikam was a descendant of David through Jehoiachin.

Azrikam@1Ch.8.38-=H5840H.brief: A descendant of Saul and Jonathan.
Azrikam@1Ch.8.38-=H5840H.short: Azrikam was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan.

Azrikam@1Ch.9.14-Neh=H5840I.short: Azrikam was a Levite who lived in Jerusalem.

Azrikam@2Ch.28.7=H5840J.brief: An official in King Ahaz's household.
Azrikam@2Ch.28.7=H5840J.short: Azrikam was an official in charge of King Ahaz's palace.

Azubah@1Ch.2.18-=H5806H.brief: Wife of Caleb and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
Azubah@1Ch.2.18-=H5806H.short: Azubah was Caleb's wife and the mother of his sons Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

Azubah@1Ki.22.42-2Ch=H5806G.short: Azubah was the mother of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

Azzan@Num.34.26=H5821.brief: Father of Paltiel, a leader from the tribe of Issachar.
Azzan@Num.34.26=H5821.short: Azzan was the father of Paltiel, a leader from Issachar chosen to help divide Canaan.

Azzur@Ezk.11.1=H5809I.brief: Father of the wicked prince Jaazaniah.
Azzur@Ezk.11.1=H5809I.short: Azzur was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the wicked princes Ezekiel saw in a vision.

Azzur@Jer.28.1=H5809H.short: Azzur was the father of Hananiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah.

Azzur@Neh.10.17=H5809G.brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
Azzur@Neh.10.17=H5809G.short: Azzur was one of the leaders who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.

Baal@1Ch.5.5=H1168G.short: Baal was a descendant of Reuben, the firstborn son of Jacob.
